text: datras_raw object list three data frames, classes datras_raw DATRASraw: DATRASraw class kept backward compatibility DATRAS R package, functions keep working datras_raw object. three tables follow DATRAS exchange format: HH: haul data. title: Matching EMODnet seabed habitats to hauls
text: EUSeaMap served EMODnet Seabed Habitats WFS. Requesting whole European map large, restrict download bounding box hauls. First, haul extent (lon/lat): EMODnet Seabed Habitats WFS endpoint https://ows.emodnet-seabedhabitats.eu/geoserver/emodnet_open/ows. can list available layers attributes service capabilities: Pick EUSeaMap layer need. European broad-scale map classified EUNIS 2019 emodnet_open:eusm2025_eunis2019_full. Download haul bounding box passing BBOX filter WFS GetFeature request. request asks GeoJSON within haul extent, st_make_valid() repairs polygons can used spatial join: key habitat attributes layer eunis2019c (EUNIS 2019 code), eunis2019d (EUNIS 2019 description), all2019d (full habitat description), alongside component descriptors substrate, energy, biozone, salinity, oxygen. Note WFS axis order EPSG:4326 lat,lon, bbox string ordered ymin,xmin,ymax,xmax. prefer, can instead download layer EMODnet Seabed Habitats download portal read local file st_read().
code: ## Bounding box of the hauls bb <- st_bbox(hauls) bb #>    xmin    ymin    xmax    ymax  #>  2.0290 54.0630  3.8461 54.9065 ## Discover available layers (run once, interactively) #wfs <- "https://ows.emodnet-seabedhabitats.eu/geoserver/emodnet_open/ows" #st_layers(paste0("WFS:", wfs)) ## WFS GetFeature request, restricted to the haul bounding box wfs   <- "https://ows.emodnet-seabedhabitats.eu/geoserver/emodnet_open/ows" layer <- "emodnet_open:eusm2025_eunis2019_full"  url <- paste0(   wfs,   "?service=WFS&version=2.0.0&request=GetFeature",   "&typeNames=", layer,   "&srsName=EPSG:4326",   "&bbox=", paste(bb["ymin"], bb["xmin"], bb["ymax"], bb["xmax"], "urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326", sep = ","),   "&outputFormat=application/json" )  habitat <- st_read(url, quiet = TRUE) habitat <- st_make_valid(habitat)  ## Inspect the attributes and choose the habitat column you want to keep names(habitat) #>  [1] "id"         "objectid"   "oxygen"     "salinity"   "energy"     #>  [6] "biozone"    "substrate"  "eunis2019c" "eunis2019d" "all2019d"   #> [11] "all2019dl2" "geometry"

text: function can read: one individual .zip files, one directories containing .zip files, optionally files matching selected years. Small zip files can excluded using min_file_size, unusually small files often incomplete corrupted may fail underlying DATRAS reader functions. DATRAS zip archives typically much larger kilobytes, small files often suspicious may represent failed downloads damaged archives. Reading large number DATRAS files R can require substantial memory, especially combining multiple surveys many years. following options can substantially reduce peak memory use: drop_hl = TRUE drops length-frequency table (HL) immediately file read.
